title: Ionization from excited hydrogen
statement:
Which hydrogen atom requires less energy to ionize, n=1 or n=3?

[_]{a}

explanations: Its binding energy is one ninth the n=1 value.
The initial state enters the energy difference.
Energy can lift an electron to the continuum.

hints: The state closer to zero needs less energy.
solution: The ionized threshold is zero. Both bound energies are negative. The state closer to zero needs less energy. Its binding energy is one ninth the n=1 value.
